{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low by ~0.5-1.0 for the first 10-15 days, showing significant lag behind price momentum",
    "Sentiment turning positive (0.67-1.00) correlates with model undershooting true prices by 0.5-1.5, especially in the near term",
    "Model fails to capture magnitude of sentiment-driven rallies, overselling prices when sentiment strengthens",
    "The gap between forecast and true prices narrows from ~1.0 early days to ~0.3-0.5 by day 20-25, showing mean-reversion in forecast error",
    "When prices are in a clear uptrend in history, model forecasts lag behind both current level and trajectory by 0.8-1.2 on days 1-10",
    "Sentiment exhaustion (0.00) regions show least forecast error, but model still under-predicts by ~0.3-0.5",
    "Model exhibits mean-reverting bias, forecasting toward mean more than true prices which continue trending"
] }
